class.name: unitree_g1_ros2_control/UnitreeG1SystemInterface
class.description: ROS2 control hardware interface for Unitree G1 humanoid robot. Communicates with the robot via Unitree SDK using DDS. Exposes joint state (position, velocity, effort) and command (position, velocity, effort, kp, kd) interfaces compatible with the MuJoCo simulation interface.
